description: This file contains implementation of SPDY protocol frame reading and parsing, including control and data frames, header decompression, and frame dispatching.

classes.name: SynStreamFrame
classes.description: Represents a SPDY SYN_STREAM control frame.

classes.name: SynReplyFrame
classes.description: Represents a SPDY SYN_REPLY control frame.

classes.name: RstStreamFrame
classes.description: Represents a SPDY RST_STREAM control frame.

classes.name: SettingsFrame
classes.description: Represents a SPDY SETTINGS control frame.

classes.name: PingFrame
classes.description: Represents a SPDY PING control frame.

classes.name: GoAwayFrame
classes.description: Represents a SPDY GOAWAY control frame.

classes.name: HeadersFrame
classes.description: Represents a SPDY HEADERS control frame.

classes.name: WindowUpdateFrame
classes.description: Represents a SPDY WINDOW_UPDATE control frame.

classes.name: Framer
classes.description: Handles reading and parsing SPDY frames from a stream.

methods.name: ReadFrame
methods.description: Reads SPDY encoded data and returns a decompressed Frame.

methods.name: parseControlFrame
methods.description: Parses a control frame based on version and frame type.

methods.name: parseDataFrame
methods.description: Parses a data frame given a stream ID.

methods.name: uncorkHeaderDecompressor
methods.description: Initializes or updates the header decompressor for header block decompression.

methods.name: readSynStreamFrame
methods.description: Reads and parses a SYN_STREAM frame.

methods.name: readSynReplyFrame
methods.description: Reads and parses a SYN_REPLY frame.

methods.name: readHeadersFrame
methods.description: Reads and parses a HEADERS frame.
